title: drupilot preflight report
description: The requirements report printed on STDOUT by scripts/env/preflight.sh --json (any --profile: analyze, setup, test, contribute or all; with or without --extended, --deep, --subject). It is never written to disk by the script itself: /drupilot-doctor, the SessionStart hook and every command gate read it from STDOUT. The object is built in one jq literal ({profile, php_target, ready, checks}); --extended adds exactly extended and toolchain. Every check row is emitted whatever the profile: the profile only selects the exit code.

profile.description: The --profile the report was computed for (default all).

php_target.description: The effective DRUPILOT_PHP_TARGET (resolve_php_target), e.g. "8.3". Not validated against a closed set.

ready.description: Readiness per profile, computed from the hard requirements whatever --profile says (test always equals setup).

checks.description: One row per checked requirement, in a fixed order (emit_check). The ids are bash, git, jq, php, composer, docker, docker_daemon, ddev, selenium, ssh_key, pat, git_identity, drupalorg, api_helper; --extended adds the health rows xmllint, sed, phpcs_config, phpstan_config, toolchain:<package>, toolchain_combo, disk_free and origin_residue (each only when it applies).

id.description: Stable row id; toolchain:<composer package> rows carry the package name.

category.description: health rows only appear with --extended and never change ready or the exit code.

profiles.description: The profiles this requirement belongs to.

kind.description: hard gates a profile; soft and info never do; manual cannot be verified by a program (the drupal.org account).

version.description: The detected version, "unknown" when present but unparseable, or "" when not applicable. Health rows put their finding here (e.g. "valid", "gnu", "1234 MB").

hint.description: OS-aware install or fix hint; "" when none.

toolchain.description: Present only with --extended: the dev toolchain installed at the Drupal root (read from composer.lock) compared with config/toolchain-reference.json; null when there is no Drupal root, no composer.lock or no reference file.

installed.description: {package: version} for each reference-pinned package found in composer.lock (a leading v stripped).

known_good.description: {package: version} from the reference, restricted to the installed packages.

differs.description: Installed packages whose version differs from the reference.

match.description: True when nothing differs and at least one package is installed.

known_broken.description: The reference's known-broken combinations every package of which is installed at a matching version.
